fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Display name of the quiz.

fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: Description (intro) of the quiz.

fields.name: introformat
fields.meaning: Text format of the intro.

fields.name: timeopen
fields.meaning: Unix timestamp: quiz opens. 0 = no opening time. Creates a calendar event (see side effects).

fields.name: timeclose
fields.meaning: Unix timestamp: quiz closes. 0 = no closing time. Creates a calendar event (see side effects).

fields.name: timelimit
fields.meaning: Time limit in seconds from attempt start. 0 = no time limit. Same field as for an assignment (assign::timelimit).

fields.name: overduehandling
fields.meaning: Overdue attempt handling: automatically submit, allow a grace period, or abandon the attempt.

fields.name: graceperiod
fields.meaning: Grace period in seconds after the time limit, during which submission is still accepted. Only effective for "overduehandling"="graceperiod"; must exceed a server-wide minimum duration (see combination rules).

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:113-116 (duration, optional, hideIf overduehandling neq graceperiod); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.graceperiod)

fields.name: preferredbehaviour
fields.meaning: Question behaviour: how and when an answer is graded and feedback given (e.g. immediate feedback, deferred feedback, deferred feedback with certainty-based marking).

value_range.source: question/engine/lib.php (question_engine::get_behaviour_options()); mod/quiz/mod_form.php:202-205; column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.preferredbehaviour, NOTNULL without DB default)

fields.name: canredoquestions
fields.meaning: Learners may redo a question already completed within the attempt. Only effective for behaviours that allow a question to finish during the attempt.

fields.name: attempts
fields.meaning: Maximum number of allowed attempts. 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: attemptonlast
fields.meaning: A new attempt carries forward the last attempt's answers (1) instead of starting empty (0). Only visible when more than one attempt is allowed.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:218-223 (selectyesno, hideIf attempts eq 1); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.attemptonlast)

fields.name: grademethod
fields.meaning: How the quiz grade is calculated across attempts: highest grade, average, first or last attempt.

fields.name: decimalpoints
fields.meaning: Decimal places displayed for the overall grade.

fields.name: questiondecimalpoints
fields.meaning: Decimal places displayed for individual question grades. -1 = same as "decimalpoints".

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:272-278 (select, -1 to QUIZ_MAX_Q_DECIMAL_OPTION); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.questiondecimalpoints, DEFAULT=-1)

fields.name: questionsperpage
fields.meaning: Number of questions before a new page starts when editing/shuffling. 0 = all questions on one page.

fields.name: navmethod
fields.meaning: Quiz navigation: jump freely between questions ("free") or proceed in order only ("sequential").

fields.name: shuffleanswers
fields.meaning: Shuffle answer parts within each question if supported by its type.

fields.name: subnet
fields.meaning: Allowed IP addresses/ranges from which a quiz attempt may be started (format as in address_in_subnet()). Empty = unrestricted.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:294-296 (text); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.subnet, NOTNULL without DB default)

fields.name: browsersecurity
fields.meaning: Browser restriction during the attempt, e.g. secure fullscreen mode. "-" = unrestricted.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/classes/access_manager.php:128 (get_browser_security_choices()); mod/quiz/mod_form.php:315-317; column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.browsersecurity, NOTNULL without DB default)

fields.name: delay1
fields.meaning: Enforced delay in seconds between the first and second attempts.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:299-304 (duration, optional, hideIf attempts eq 1); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.delay1)

fields.name: delay2
fields.meaning: Enforced delay in seconds between the second and subsequent attempts.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:306-312 (duration, optional, hideIf attempts eq 1 or eq 2); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.delay2)

fields.name: showuserpicture
fields.meaning: Show the user picture during the attempt and on the review page: none, small or large.

fields.name: showblocks
fields.meaning: Show blocks during the quiz attempt.

fields.name: allowofflineattempts
fields.meaning: Allow offline quiz attempts in the Moodle app. Provided by access rule plugin quizaccess_offlineattempts, not the form core itself.

fields.name: precreateattempts
fields.meaning: Precreate attempts for learners. Only visible when administration has configured a precreation time window AND "timeopen" is set.

value_range.source: mod/quiz/mod_form.php:118-135 (select, conditionally visible); column mod/quiz/db/install.xml (quiz.precreateattempts, NULLable)

pseudofields.name: gradepass
pseudofields.meaning: Passing grade in quiz grade points, NOT percent: a finite JSON number from 0 to the maximum grade (inclusive); 0 disables the passing threshold. For 80%, read the current grade with get_module_settings and supply 0.8 * grade (10 -> 8, 25 -> 20). If the grade parameter changes the maximum in the same call, use that new maximum.

pseudofields.name: quizpassword
pseudofields.meaning: Password required before starting/resuming a quiz attempt. Empty = no password. Form name for the "password" column (see blocklist) - both refer to the same field, but only "quizpassword" is writable through the form path.

pseudofields.name: feedbacktext
pseudofields.meaning: Overall feedback texts by grade band, sorted descending - ONE field, not a field sequence: feedbacktext[0] is feedback for 100% down to the first boundary. Only effective when "grade" (blocklist) is greater than 0.

pseudofields.name: feedbackboundaries
pseudofields.meaning: Grade boundaries for feedback bands, linked by the same key as "feedbacktext" - one fewer than feedbacktext entries. Absolute or percentage (e.g. "50%"), must be sorted descending and between 0 and "grade" (see combination rules).

combination_rules: "timeclose" must not precede "timeopen" when both are set (mod/quiz/mod_form.php: validation()).
"graceperiod" must exceed a server-wide minimum duration (admin setting "graceperiodmin") when "overduehandling"="graceperiod" (validation()).
"feedbackboundaries[]" must be sorted descending and each value must be between 0 and "grade" ; the count must be exactly one fewer than "feedbacktext[]" (validation()).

"gradepass" must be a finite JSON number from 0 to the effective maximum grade inclusive, in grade points, not percent. Coursepilot enforces this range for every question behaviour. 0 disables the passing threshold; a simultaneous grade change supplies the new maximum.
side_effects: "timeopen"/"timeclose" each create or update a calendar event (mod/quiz/lib.php: quiz_update_events()).

attempts.reason: Once all attempts are used up, another try needs a user override by the teacher.

navmethod.reason: Learners cannot return to earlier questions to correct them.

timeclose.reason: After the close date no attempt is possible unless the teacher grants an override.

timelimit.reason: When the time runs out the attempt is submitted; another try needs a free attempt or an override.

quizpassword.reason: Learners need the password from the teacher to start an attempt.

subnet.reason: Attempts only work from the listed network; anywhere else the teacher has to step in.

browsersecurity.reason: Attempts need a special browser setup the teacher has to provide.
